mapper.insert: INSERT INTO artifact_share_request (tenant_id, workitem_id, dispatch_id, name, sha256) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workitemId}, #{dispatchId}, #{name}, #{sha256}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM artifact_share_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dispatch_id = #{dispatchId} AND name = #{name}
SELECT * FROM artifact_share_request WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM artifact_share_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND workitem_id = #{workitemId} AND id = #{id}

SELECT id FROM artifact_share_request WHERE status = 'PENDING'
AND dispatch_id = #{dispatchId} AND next_attempt_at <= NOW(3)
ORDER BY next_attempt_at, id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE artifact_share_request SET next_attempt_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
